description: This file implements a health monitoring service for agent nodes, including registration, periodic HTTP health checks, status updates, MCP health assessments, and recovery mechanisms. It manages active agents, performs status polling, updates a unified status system or legacy storage, and broadcasts events related to health status changes.

classes.name: HealthMonitorConfig
classes.description: Configuration settings for the health monitor, primarily the check interval.

classes.name: ActiveAgent
classes.description: Represents an actively monitored agent, tracking node ID, base URL, last known health status, and last check time.

classes.name: HealthMonitor
classes.description: Main service class responsible for monitoring, registering/unregistering agents, performing health checks, and updating statuses.

methods.name: NewHealthMonitor
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new HealthMonitor with provided dependencies and default settings.

methods.name: RegisterAgent
methods.description: Adds an agent to the active monitoring list and optionally updates presence.

methods.name: UnregisterAgent
methods.description: Removes an agent from the monitoring list and updates the status to inactive, broadcasting relevant events.

methods.name: RecoverFromDatabase
methods.description: Loads previously registered agents from the database on startup, restores monitoring, and performs initial health checks.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the periodic HTTP health checking loop based on the set interval.

methods.name: checkActiveAgents
methods.description: Performs health checks on all registered active agents.

methods.name: checkAgentHealth
methods.description: Sends an HTTP /status request to an agent and updates status accordingly, enforcing debounce logic.

methods.name: checkMCPHealthForNode
methods.description: Retrieves and processes MCP health data from an agent, updating internal cache and broadcasting changes.

methods.name: hasMCPHealthChanged
methods.description: Determines if the MCP health data for a node has changed enough to trigger an event.

methods.name: updateMCPHealthCache
methods.description: Updates the cached MCP health data for a node.

methods.name: GetMCPHealthCache
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current MCP health cache for external inspection.
